label: coach_bb_brother_first_01
text: [EMPTY 69]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_01
text: 和乌栗他们一起去的\n校外活动，你感觉怎么样？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_01
text: 很轻松！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_02
text: 很辛苦！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_02
text: 有[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你在的话，\n就是小菜一碟吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_02b
text: 就是啊！\n真是辛苦你了。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_03
text: 你们调查了帕底亚地区\n那个巨大的洞吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_04
text: 才刚来留学\n就让你回帕底亚……\r\n是不是有点过分呀？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_03
text: 我不在意！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_04
text: 确实……

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_05
text: 哦，你很成熟嘛……\n要是我的话就会抱怨了。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_05b
text: 就是就是！\n我觉得这样不好哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_06
text: 这所学园太自由了，\n有时候就会这样……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_07
text: 你要是觉得有什么不好的地方，\n就明确指出吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_01
text: 我来汇报一下[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n外出期间联盟社的情况吧。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_02
text: 首先……为了防止混乱，\n现在暂停了\r\n蓝莓联盟的排名变动！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_03
text: 还正式追加了留学生\n也可以成为冠军的规则！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_04
text: 被乌栗改掉的社规中太严格的部分，\n我们重新考虑并把这部分改了回去！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_05
text: ……还有很多！\n我们做了很多事哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_select_01
text: 谢谢！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_select_02
text: 辛苦了。

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_06
text: ……啊！抱歉！\n可能听起来像是强行让你感谢一样。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_07
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你不要在意！\n因为这是我们的责任……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_08
text: ……但杜若还是老样子，\n在开会的时候睡、着、了！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_09
text: ……就是这些！\n联盟社的近况汇报完毕～！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_01
text: 之前乌栗当冠军的时候，\n社里的气氛非常沉重……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_02
text: 甚至有人因为\n受不了而离开社团。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_03
text: ……所以！我想\n让[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\r\n决定联盟社今后的方针！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_04
text: 你有什么好的方针吗？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_01
text: 边享乐边努力！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_02
text: 开朗有活力！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_03
text: 安全第一！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05
text: “边享乐边努力”……\n嗯！我觉得很好！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05b
text: “开朗有活力”……\n嗯！我觉得很好！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05c
text: “安全第一”……\n总觉得像工地似的。\r\n……啊，我觉得挺～好的。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_06
text: 这样社里的气氛\n一定能变得更好！\r\n谢谢你！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_00
text: 这样的话，必须要做的事情\n应该差不多都处理好了……！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_01
text: 一下子感觉好累……\n好想分享可爱来疗愈疲劳啊～[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_02
text: ……[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！不介意的话，\n你愿意和我交换宝可梦吗？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_03
text: 好开心！\n我用布鲁和你换吧！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你呢？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]，好可爱～！
你的选择可爱过头啦～！\c
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！
谢谢你和我交换！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_02_01
text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_02_02
text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_02_03
text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_03_00
text:
同行宝可梦只有１只的话，
是无法用来交换的哦。\c
等你带着２只以上时
再来找我吧。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_03_01
text: 你不换了吗？\n唔嗯嗯，好遗憾……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_04_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n你愿意和我交换宝可梦吗？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_talkto_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n你愿意和我来场宝可梦对战吗？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_cancel_00
text: 我随时等你哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battlestart_00
text: 让你见识一下\n可爱的力量！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battlestart_01
text:
蓝莓学园的主流
是双打对战！\c
准备好２只以上的
宝可梦再来吧。

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_00
text: 你果然好厉害！\n但是也很可爱！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_01
text: 你给了我这么多可爱，\n我也要给你回礼才行……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_02
text: 这是联盟社\n制作的手机壳！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_03
text: 你不介意的话，\n就用用看吧。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_reward_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从紫竽那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]蓝莓手机壳（白）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_01_00
text: 辛苦了！\n不介意的话，请收下这个！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_01_01
text: 今天也收获了\n好～多可爱，太满足了！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_lose_00_00
text: 不论谁赢，\n这都是一场可爱的对战！\r\n为努力的宝可梦送上掌声吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_randomtalk_00
text:
杜若这个人啊，
为什么这么不像话。\c
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你也要
说说他才行。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_randomtalk_01
text: 乌栗改变形象之后，\n虽然性格变了，\r\n但外表很可爱……对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_randomtalk_02
text:
我爸是道馆馆主，
外表非～常可怕哦。\c
甚至就算有男生跟我搭话，
报出我爸的名字也会吓跑他们。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_randomtalk_04
text:
我交换给你的布鲁
没有因为可爱过头而添麻烦吧？\c
等把它培育成布鲁皇以后，
试试枕着它的肚子睡觉吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
